sceneDescription: Iyo yepakati inomiririra iyi bhurawuza yeHelia node. Bright green node parizvino dzakabatana nebrowser uye dzine mutsetse wepakati. Violet node dzakawanikwa nebrowser routing asi haina kubatana. Node dzegoridhe dzakavhurika zvinongedzo zvinoshumwa neyakaparadzana yemuno Kubo daemon; haasi mabrowser ekubatanidza uye haana mutsara wepakati pano. Slate nyeredzi dzakafa dzinochengetedza nhoroondo yakabviswa, uye humbowo hwadzo hunobviswa chete mushure mekubviswa. Distance kubva pakati pemepu akapimwa latency; vezera vasina kuyerwa vanotora nzira yekunze, uye mapoka emakona echokufambisa chakacherechedzwa. Decorative background nyeredzi hadzimiriri vezera. Iyo yakafenda yekunze orbit inoratidza iyo inotengeswa kunze kwenyika Kubo munda uye haisi yekubatanidza. Iyo relay mupendero inoonekwa chete kana iyo relay ID iripo mune yakacherechedzwa peer set; zvekupokana peer-to-peer topology haina kumbotaurwa. Shandisa peerexplorer kune rumwe ruzivo mune zvinyorwa zvinyorwa.
fallbackBody: Mudziyo uyu watadza kugadzira chimiro cheWebGL chakachengeteka. Rarama maonero eHelia anoramba aripo kuburikidza nemuongorori wevezera.
distanceAxis: Distance = measure latency · outer orbit = isina kuyerwa

brightnessAxis: Kupenya kwemutsara wekubatanidza = kukurumidza kuyerwa mhinduro
observationScopeBody: Iyi bhurawuza inosvikika nharaunda pamwe nekunze zvakatorwa kunze kwenyika Kubo zvakaonekwa; yakateverwa pa2,048 uye yakashandurwa pa1,024, kwete iyo yese IPFS network.
heroTitle: Live browser observatory · denga mhenyu kune vezera rinosvikika
heroBody: Iri bhurawuza rinocherekedza vezera rinosvikika, rinoyera mhinduro dzavo, uye rinopa humbowo kubva muchikamu chino. Hapana chinofananidzwa pano.
settingsSummaryAuto: Auto quality inodzivirira furemu chiyero uye inopora kana chiitiko chatonhorera.

controlsOrbit: Bata kudhonza kuruboshwe, kana chinja kukona-kurudyi kamera modhi, kutenderera.
controlsHover: Hover a zera kuti uwane ruzivo; baya kana kudzvanya kuti upinise kadhi rayo reuchapupu.
controlsSelect: [/] sarudza vezera, Isa mapini, Esc inodzinga.
controlsTouch: Pamasikirini ekubata, swipe ku orbit, tsikirira kuti ufambe, uye baya kuti ubaye.
